structure: Each independent person has a bivariate stable component B and independent bivariate deviations E1 and E2. Measurements are B+E1 and B+E2. The three latent vectors are mutually independent and Gaussian. The scenario combines positive stable X-Y association with negative within-visit deviation association.

parameter_provenance.basis: Both biomarkers have population mean zero; deviations have mean zero.
Exact variances of the stable components.

parameter_provenance.value: Persons independent; stable component independent of deviations; deviation vectors independent between visits.

parameter_provenance.basis: Chosen scenario; C supplies no cross-biomarker stable covariance.
Chosen scenario, equal at both visits; C supplies no within-visit cross-biomarker deviation covariance.
Gaussian latent vectors are a convenient sampling choice, not an evidence-derived distribution.
At either visit, independent stable and deviation variances add: 4+1=5.
Stable components cancel, and independent visit deviations give variance 1+1=2.
Conditional on chosen correlations: stable covariance=4(0.75)=3; deviation covariance=-0.5; same-visit covariance=3-0.5; cross-visit covariance=3; change covariance=2(-0.5).

requested_estimands.name: change_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: Changes contain only deviations. With the chosen common within-visit correlation r_w, their covariance is 2r_w and each variance is 2, giving correlation r_w=-0.5. C does not determine r_w.

requested_estimands.name: same_visit_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: At either visit, correlation=(4r_b+r_w)/5=(3-0.5)/5=0.5. Neither r_b nor r_w is supplied by C; their equality across visits for deviations is also a scenario choice.

requested_estimands.name: cross_visit_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: Independent visit deviations leave only stable cross-biomarker covariance: correlation=4r_b/5=3/5=0.6. C does not determine r_b.

limitations: None of the three requested correlations is identified by C alone. The reported variances and independence assumptions identify marginal measurement variances and change variances, but not cross-biomarker covariances.
Equal within-visit cross-biomarker covariance across visits is chosen, not reported.
The listed correlations are population scenario values. Random finite samples will fluctuate; the generator does not force empirical moments or select persons or seeds.
The supplied standardized arbitrary units do not imply unit marginal variance: the stipulated measurement variance is 5.
This is an artificial mathematical scenario, not biomedical validation.
checks_actually_performed: Analytically checked positive definiteness: stable covariance [[4,3],[3,4]] has eigenvalues 1 and 7; deviation covariance [[1,-0.5],[-0.5,1]] has eigenvalues 0.5 and 1.5.
Algebraically derived measurement variances, change variances, and all three population correlations using the stipulated independence structure.
Reviewed the source for the required wide column order, unique integer identifiers, independent person-level draws, seeded randomness, and absence of empirical moment adjustment.
No code execution or empirical simulation checks were performed.
